newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Survey finds 60 pct of HK bourse turnover local.
newsitem.headline: Survey finds 60 pct of HK bourse turnover local.

text.p: Local retail investors and local institutional investors accounted for 60 percent of total Stock Exchange of Hong Kong turnover in the year to September 1996, according to a stock exchange survey.
The annual survey found that local retail investors accounted for 34 percent of total market turnover, and local institutional investors accounted for another 26 percent.
Overseas institutional investors accounted for 30 percent of turnover, overseas individual trading for two percent, and principal trading for eight percent, it said.
The annual survey also found that small members had been gaining more institutional and overseas investor business.

The annual survey of 297 trading members representing all members contributing to the top two thirds of market turnover and a random sample of 60 percent of the rest, had an overall response rate of 99 percent the exchange said.
